testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel a later edit after applying a custom command: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:374:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a later edit after applying a custom command ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Part Tools custom panel is initially empty ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog is open ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel and clicks "Apply" ✔ Then the User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon ✔ When the user adds "3D Annotations" to the custom panel and clicks "Cancel" ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the User Commands panel remains visible ✔ When the user reopens ribbon customization ✔ Then the Part Tools custom panel contains "2D Sketches" ✔ And "3D Annotations" is available in the source list ✔ And no pending-change marker is shown
